refusal.text: the reading was refused because it changes a measure computed from Athena's records (it changes crates/athena-core/src/status/planning.rs, which computes the figures status prints) but no behavior criterion runs it against real records with an expected range from an independent source; missing from the nearest behavior criterion: `real records`, an independent source of the range (`git log`, `history.json`, `commit times`, `recorded check durations`, `recorded durations` or `landing record timestamps`), an `expected range`. A measure verified on fixture records alone has shown wrong figures on the real records (2026-10-29: a landing time of 0.1 minutes, then 273.8 minutes, against real landings of a few minutes). Add one behavior criterion that names `real records`, an independent source and the `expected range`, for example: "Run `cargo run -p athena-cli -- status --snapshot <evidence directory>`: on the real records the landing time it prints is within the expected range taken from the commit times in history.json". The range must come from a source the change does not compute; the status output is the real output compared with it. `git log` also needs an `Environment:` assumption naming the site, read permission and the records or history it reaches. A split or move of the figure modules with no behavior change needs the same criterion, because a moved figure can change
